Commentary.Commentary: Right then! Ebony Rainford Brent reckoned that at the pitch report that anything around 125 is competitive. India have got 13 less. Momentum is with England but considering the spin on the track, the Asian side should not be too dissatisfied. Stay tuned...

An innings in two halves for England. The first half was very shoddy, with missed stumpings, dropped catches, misfields, etc... But that Beaumont run out of Rodrigues changed the mindset. Captain Heather Knight helped herself to figures of 2-0-9-3 while Ecclestone and Gordon took 2 wickets each.

One can understand the rationalism of the Indian batters aiming to go hard. But one cannot understand all the batters committing the same mistake. Surely someone should have been there till the end and perhaps that is where Kaur faltered today. She looked in good touch but could have delayed that attacking shot a bit, given that Rodrigues and Krishnamurthy had just fallen.

It started off nicely for India, with the openers adding 43 in the Powerplay and then Kaur and Rodrigues counter-attacking with a 36-run stand in 31 balls. But one inspirational piece of fielding from Tammy Beaumont, leading to the run out of Rodrigues opened the floodgates. India collapsed from 89/2 to 112 all out.
Well, have you heard the saying - 'You live the sword and you also die by it?' Hmmm... India have done something similar here. In their quest to get to 150, they have ended up 40 runs short.

OUT! A run out to cap a mysterious collapse from India. They have lost 8/23 in 35 balls. Full and outside off, Poonam dabs it towards short third man and sees it go straight to the fielder. Deepti wants a single but it is not there. Danielle Hazell returns a quick throw to Amy Jones who takes the bails off. Sharma is not even close to the line. ENGLAND NEED 113 TO MEET AUSTRALIA!
And is that the end of the innings? Run out referred  upstairs...
Poonam Yadav is the last batter in.
OUT! Easy stumping. Full and outside off, Reddy jumps out wildly and swings. Is nowhere near the pitch of the ball and misses. Amy Jones behind doesn't.
Full and around off, swept through mid-wicket for a single.
Sophie Ecclestone to bowl the final over. 3-0-21-1 so far.
Jumps out again and miscues this straight up in the air but bisects long on and long off. Two runs taken.
FOUR! BLUDGEONED! Much needed for India. Full and around off, Reddy gets down and mows it over mid-wicket for a boundary!
Outside off, slower in pace, Arundhati looks to pull but misses.
Outside off, pushed towards cover. Now Reddy wants a run but then sends Deepti back. Direct hit would have had Sharma.
On middle, slogged to long on for a single.
Arundhati Reddy comes in at number 10, replacing Radha.

OUT! WYATT a bull's eye! After an ordinary start, England's fielding has picked up in the last 30 minutes or so. Full and outside off, Radha pushes it in front or cover and sets off for a single. Meanwhile, Danielle Wyatt takes off from cover, gets to the ball, has a shy at the non-striker's end and hits. It is referred upstairs and replays confirm that Yadav is short.
Direct hit! Is Radha short? Referred upstairs...
Unselfish move. Heather Knight does not go for the hat-trick. Anya Shrubsole is back on. 3-0-16-0 so far. India will not mind it too much though. Pace on the ball will help.
Full and around off, Sharma comes down the track to flick but gets a leading edge to cover.
Another long hop, pulled behind square leg for one.
Full and outside off, swept hard to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Full and outside off, Deepti looks to sweep but misses.
On middle and leg, flicked away for a single.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a couple. 100 UP FOR INDIA. Run-a-ball from here will take them to a competitive total.
Radha Yadav comes in at number 9, replacing Patil. Danielle Hazell returns too. 3-0-15-0 so far.

OUT! Sensational catch from Lauren Winfield and Knight is on a hat-trick! Smart bowling, not-so-great batting and a terrific piece of fielding. Tossed up around middle, Anuja is down the track to the very first ball she faces but is nowhere near the pitch of the ball. Skies it miles in the air but seems to have bisected long on and long off. However, Lauren Winfield charges in from long on and dives to take a spectacular catch! 4 wickets in the last 2 overs.
Anuja Patil walks in next, at number 8, replacing Hemalatha.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another soft dismissal. The captain has her second. Full and outside off, Hemalatha reaches out to drive, cannot keep it down and hands Tammy Beaumont at short extra cover an absolute sitter.
Full and around off, swept powerfully to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Full and outside off, chipped over cover for a couple.
Short again, this time cut to the left of point for a single.
Gets away with that one. Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
The skipper is on. Heather Knight. 1-0-5-1 so far.
Comes down the track but works it straight to short mid-wicket. What an over - A run, a wide and 2 wickets. Can England make use of this?
WIDE. Massive turn again. Full and outside off, Deepti gets a long way across to sweep but the ball spins in past the leg stump.
Dayalan Hemalatha walks in at number 7, replacing Kaur.

OUT! Big, big wicket! Second strike in the over for Gordon. Kaur is gone. Full and outside off, Harmanpreet comes down the track and looks to go straight but the ball goes away from her and takes the top edge. Two players converge under it - point and the keeper - in the end, Natalie Sciver calls for it and takes it comfortably.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Gets a long way across and helps it to fine leg for a single.
Around off, spinning in, helped straight to square leg.
Deepti Sharma comes in at number 6, replacing Krishnamurthy.

OUT! CAUGHT! England keeping themselves in the game with wickets at regular intervals. Full and outside off, turning away, Krishnamurthy comes down the track and has an ugly hoick. Only gets a top edge which lobs straight up to the keeper behind.
A short ball once more, heaved through square leg for another single.
Full and around off, watchfully blocked out.
A long hop, dragged behind square leg for one.
Outside off, punched straight to point.
Dropped short, pulled through mid-wicket for a run.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
Anya Shrubsole is back on. 2-0-12-0 so far.

Full and outside off, massive turn, Krishnamurthy looks to defend but misses. Jones collects and quickly whips off the bails and appeals - FOR A CATCH. No one else has heard anything. England have a discussion but do not review. Nothing on that.
Veda Krishnamurthy comes in at number 5, replacing Rodrigues.

OUT! Superb piece of fielding. A length ball outside off, Rodrigues comes down the track and just about evades the sliding fielder from cover. Tammy Beaumont gets to the ball quickly from backward point and returns a rocket throw to the keeper who dislodges the bails. Jemimah tries to get in and on being referred upstairs the bat is found on the line.
Is that a run out? Jemimah Rodrigues looks to be in trouble. Referred upstairs...
Around off, watchfully defended.

FOUR! Sloppy from England. Full and around off, Rodrigues looks to hit this over long on, mistimes it and the fielder thinks she has a chance. She comes running in for the catch but cannot get even close to the ball. Worse, she cannot stop it from going past her into the fence.

IN THE AIR... SAFE! More luck for India. Full and around off, Harmanpreet comes down the track and looks to go straighter this time. Miscues it, getting more height than distance. Luckily for her, the ball lands right between long on and long off. A single taken. Kaur is not happy, she wanted two there.
SIX! Hat-trick of boundaries for India! Full and outside off, Kaur steps out and lofts it cleanly over long off!
FOUR! This is even better! Landed outside off, Rodrigues goes back, opens the face of her bat and dabs it finer of short third man for consecutive boundaries! 10 from the over!
FOUR! Super shot. Fractionally short outside off, Rodrigues goes back and cuts it between point and short third man for a boundary!
Short and outside off, pulled behind square leg for a run.
Outside off, compactly defended.
Around off, Kaur wants to drop and run to the off side but is stopped as the keeper gets across swiftly to her right. Jones tries a back-flick onto the stumps at the striker's end but misses.
Dropped short, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Natalie Sciver is back on. 1-0-6-0 so far.
TOP EDGE, SAFE! Luck continues to go India's way. Full and outside off, Jemimah looks to sweep but gets a top edge. It lobs over the keeper's head. A single taken.
Dropped short, pulled to short fine leg where a decent sliding stop prevents runs. There is a slight mix-up in the middle between the batters but they return safely.
Outside off, guided behind point with soft hands for a quick single.
Fired in on middle, well defended.
Comes down the track this time but gets an inside edge onto her pads.
Short and outside off, Kaur looks to cut but gets a bottom edge.
WIDE. Another one down the leg side.
Sophie Ecclestone returns. 2-0-18-1 so far.
Comes down the track but is beaten in flight. Is hit on the pads.
On middle, worked through wide mid on for another single.
WIDE. Massive turn. Down the leg side. good keeping from the stumper as Kaur misses her flick.
Another sweep, this time behind square leg, for one.
Goes back and defends.
On middle and leg, flicked away for a run.
Full and outside off, swept behind square leg for a single.
Danielle Hazell is back on. 2-0-10-0 so far.
Comes down the track this time and eases it to long off for one more. Halfway stage - India are 59/2. Comfortably poised to get to 130-150.
Around off once more, Rodrigues blocks.
Full and around off, Kaur uses her feet and drives it towards long off for a run.
Short and around off once again, pulled to deep mid-wicket for single.
Landed around off, turning away once again, blocked towards cover with soft hands for a single.
Full and around off, spinning away, pushed towards cover.
Outside off, played with soft hands behind point for one. 5 runs and a wicket from the skipper's over.
Dropped short, bludgeoned away to deep mid-wicket for a run.
In comes the Indian skipper now. Harmanpreet Kaur.

OUT! CAUGHT! The captain has struck. Full on middle, Bhatia jumps down the track, is far from the fall, tries to drag it through the on side and ends up scooping it in the air. Simple catch for Natalie Sciver running to her left from short mid-wicket.
On middle, whipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Dropped short, pulled through mid-wicket for a couple.
Full on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Heather Knight brings herself on.
Full and outside off, swept to deep square leg for a run.
Outside off, Jemimah looks to cut but gets a bottom edge to the keeper's pads, on the bounce.
A short ball outside off, JR looks to pull but is way too early. Jones whips off the bails and appeals. It is referred upstairs and replays show that Rodrigues never left the crease.
Full and outside off, sweep shot missed.

MIX-UP, SAFE! Full and outside off, Rodrigues comes halfway down the track, looks to flick but the ball spins away and goes off the leading edge to short third man. Jemimah wants the single but is rightly sent back as Bhatia would have never made it. Luckily for India, the throw is wide of the keeper.
A short ball, comes slow off the pitch, pulled behind square leg for a single.
Kirstie Gordon to roll her arm over.
Comes down the track once  more and pushes it to long on for one.
Full and outside off, sweep shot missed.

Pre-matured dive but it is good enough to save a boundary. Full and outside off, Rodrigues comes down the track and drives it between cover and mid off. The latter dives to her left in advance but manages to parry the ball to cover, restricting the batters to a single.
Comes down the track and whips it through mid on for a run.

Huge LBW shout, but not out. Inside edge. Full and outside off, spinning in, Rodrigues plays right across the line and misses, getting hit on the pads. A feather on it as the ball rolls to point. A single taken.
Full and outside off, Bhatia comes down the track and pushes it down to long on for a single.
Jemimah Rodrigues walks in at number 3, replacing Mandhana.

OUT! Stop the press. England have taken a catch. A soft dismissal for Mandhana. England will not mind though. Landed outside off, spinning in, Smriti looks to punch it through the off side but is done in by the slowness of the pitch. Tries to correct herself by aiming to play it back but spoons it towards Ecclestone who manages to put in a dive to her left and grab the catch. Decent opening stand for India.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a couple. Hang on - A SHORT RUN IS SIGNALLED. Mandhana was the culprit.
FOUR! Full and around off, Mandhana gets across to attempt the paddle and just about gets it past the keeper to the fine leg fence.
Gets across and works it through square leg for one.
Full and around middle, Mandhana looks to sweep but gloves it over the keeper down to fine leg. A run taken.
Jumps down the track well in advance and the bowler shortens her length. Bhatia is forced to push it down to long off for a single.

MISCUE, FOUR! The Indian openers are taking their chances and getting away with it. Full and outside off, Mandhana dances down the track and looks to go inside out but does not quite hit it cleanly. Sweeper cover tries to get around to her left in the deep but in vain.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
On middle and leg, helped through square leg for a single.
Full and around middle, Bhatia looks to sweep but gets a bit of a top edge to short fine leg. Lands just short.
Full on middle, pushed back to the bowler.

That has missed everything! The Indian spinners will be licking their lips. Full and outside off, Bhatia gets down and across to sweep but is done in by the turn. The ball spins in a long way, beats the bat and misses the leg stump too! Two byes taken down to fine leg.
Danielle Hazell into the attack.
Outside off, played straight to point. 10 from the over!
Short and outside off, Smriti looks to cut but is beaten by the bounce.
SIX! Supreme shot. Full and outside off, Mandhana gets down and mows it over mid-wicket for half a dozen!
Defends this from the crease.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
FOUR! BLAST! Insult to injury for Ecclestone. After the drop, she has been picked up and dispatched. Full and on middle, Mandhana gets down and across and sweeps it over square leg for a boundary.
Sophie Ecclestone introduced now. Can she make amends for the dropped catch?

IN THE AIR... DROPPED! England's fielding has not been the best in this competition and this the second big moment that they have missed tonight. Full and outside off, Smriti drives it uppishly through the covers where Sophie Ecclestone is not sure whether to go with fingers pointed up or down and shells the opportunity. A run taken.
FOUR! Better cricket from Mandhana. Need not compulsarily play big shots. Length ball outside off, punched behind point for a boundary.
TOP EDGE, SAFE! Slightly short, on middle, SM looks to pull but the bounce does her in. Takes the top edge and clears the fielder running back from short fine leg. Another couple.
Full and outside off, Smriti looks to go over cover but miscues it slightly. Luckily for her, the breeze takes it away from the infield. Two runs taken.
Full and wide outside off, swinging way too much, Mandhana looks to drive but misses. Close to being called a wide.
Landed around middle, swinging away, blocked towards point.
Around middle, Smriti goes back and looks to dab it to third man but gets a bottom edge towards square leg. A quick single stolen.
Another crispy-looking drive but this time the ball goes to point.

FOUR! PRISTINE! First boundary of the second semi-final. Full and outside off, swinging away, Mandhana leans, gets her feet to the pitch of the ball and drives it beautifully through the covers. Stylish way to get off the mark.
Landed outside off, Mandhana looks to guide it towards third man but misses.
Well played. Stays in her crease, waits for the ball to come and steers it to third man for a single.
Outside off, once again Bhatia walks into the shot and pushes the ball to cover.
Natalie Sciver to bowl from the other end.
Landed outside off, this becomes the mighty outswinger to a left-hander, Mandhana chases and misses.
Works it with the spin this tie, through square leg for a single.
The inswinger again, Bhatia misses her flick and is hit on the pads.
MISSED STUMPING! Early let-off for Bhatia. Full and outside off, the leg cutter, TB walks into the shot, not quite watching the ball and misses her defense. Amy Jones behind is unable to collect.
Landed outside off, Taniya looks to guide it to third man but is beaten.
Big inswinger first up, nicely flicked behind square leg for a couple.

Okay! The national anthems are done and dusted and we are ready for the game to begin. The England players get into a huddle. Out come the Indian openers - Smriti Mandhana and Taniya Bhatia. The latter to take strike. England starting with Anya Shrubsole with the keeper up. Bhatia to face. Here we go!
Time for the national anthems. India's first up.

PITCH REPORT - Ebony Rainford Brent doing the pitch report, observes that the track has a bit in it for everybody. Adds further that it looks hard which will keep the seamers interested but there will be plenty of bounce and turn for the spinners. Reckons that anything above 125 keeps one in the game.

English captain, Heather Knight, says that she would have batted first too but now, would love to bowl well and restrict India to a chaseable total. Admits that there is plenty of room for improvement given their inconsistent show during the league stage and wants her side to pull its socks up.

Indian skipper, Harmanpreet Kaur, says that the Indian team has done well setting totals in the last 2 games, hence the decision. Informs that MITHALI RAJ IS NOT PLAYING but the reason given is that they have stuck to the winning combination from the last match and hence made no changes. Is not too perturbed about playing their first night fixture in this tournament and says that India are prepared to play under any conditions.
TOSS TIME. All in readiness. Heather Knight spins the coin, Harmanpreet Kaur calls HEADS and it is a HEAD. INDIA ELECT TO BAT FIRST.

To win any tournament, form and consistency are the keys. India have done that superbly and can arguably call themselves as the most superior side as even though Windies too topped the table from their group, the Asian side had tougher opponents in Australia and New Zealand, possibly known as the Group of Death. Yet they excelled with flying colours. Just a bit of worry regarding the middle order and if England can expose that early, it will be an interesting game. Hopefully, we do not get a one-sided contest unlike the previous match.

Back for the second semi-final! Not as much cheer from the fans as a few of them have already left. The home side is out of the tournament but we have still got two matches to play. In another 'revenge' match, India take on England after their 2017 World Cup final showdown. A few minutes ago, Australia extracted their revenge after their defeat to the Windies during the 2016 WT20 final. Will England be able to prevent India from doing that?
